qa_pairs.question: What screw size is specified for the mount bracket to transmission attachment?
Which transmission mount connections use M10 bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: Both the transmission mounts (rubber) to body (1AZ) and the transmission cross member to body (2AZ) use M10 bolts.

qa_pairs.question: Are the torque specifications the same for both rubber transmission mounts and cross member mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both the transmission mounts (rubber) to body and transmission cross member to body require 42 Nm of torque.

qa_pairs.question: What type of vehicle application do these torque specifications apply to?
qa_pairs.answer: All vehicle types, as indicated in the Type column.

qa_pairs.question: Which connection requires the lowest torque value among the transmission mount specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: The mount bracket to transmission connection (3AZ) requires the lowest torque at 21 Nm.
